Can I transfer my phone number to use it with Zendesk Voice (formerly Talk) or Zendesk Sales?

  • Toll-free numbers have more restrictions than local numbers and take more time to port. Learn more about toll-free ports in Twilio’s help center.

For more information about the port process, see:

  • Port a number to Sales Voice

articles.body:
Question

Can I use an email alias, distribution list, shared mailbox, or Google Group as a support address?

Answer

Zendesk does not support the use of aliases, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, Google Groups, or non-standard email clients or services. These configurations add routing complexities and cause issues with troubleshooting. However, many companies successfully set up and maintain these configurations without issue. Zendesk does not block their use.

To connect these configurations, see To add an external support address in Zendesk.

While aliases, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, and Google Groups are common, they can introduce unique challenges and complications:

  • Complex routing and troubleshooting. Adding another layer of processing increases deliverability risks due to spam filters or lost emails.
  • Malformation of email headers. Relays can alter email headers, which causes Sender Policy Framework (SPF), DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM), or Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance (DMARC) issues.
  • Fickle nature of email processing. Email behavior can vary based on the processor and parameters, which highlights the need for a direct and simple pathway.
Note: Zendesk highly recommends the use of standard email addresses for maximum deliverability. Unsupported configurations like these can cause issues that an admin cannot troubleshoot. If you use these options, Zendesk cannot help with any problems that arise.

To connect to a Google Group, see How do I use Google Groups as a support address?

articles.name: My Facebook or Instagram integration stopped working
articles.title: My Facebook or Instagram integration stopped working
articles.body:
Issue symptoms

Your Facebook integration, Facebook Messenger, or Instagram Direct channel does not sync or work correctly. You see one of these errors:

  • Messages from Facebook or Instagram do not create tickets
  • Facebook or Instagram users do not receive agent responses
  • You receive an email notification that your Facebook page was deauthorized

    Attention required: Facebook Page, [Name of the page], is no longer authorized
  • You try to reauthorize your Facebook account with Zendesk, but you get an error. The browser shows that the page is linked, but when you return to Zendesk, you see the error below.

    Page not found. The page you're looking for either doesn't exist or you don't have access to it. You cannot reauthorize your Facebook page.

Resolution steps

Important: If you cannot connect your Facebook account to Zendesk for the first time, see Setting up your public Facebook channel.

Zendesk monitors your Facebook pages for new posts, messages, and comments. If Zendesk cannot connect to your Facebook page, it sends an email notification to all admins on your account.

Your Facebook channel can become deauthorized for different reasons:

  • The admin who authorized the Facebook page revoked their Facebook session. This happens when the admin changes their password or signs out of a device after a password change.
  • The admin who added the page removed permissions for the Zendesk Facebook app to manage your pages or access your Facebook page messages.
  • Zendesk receives a consistent response from Facebook indicating that Zendesk is not authorized to access the content of the page. This should only happen due to an error in the platform of Facebook.
  • You have not granted Zendesk management access to your account. For more information, see Setting up your public Facebook channel.

Use the steps below:

Reauthorize the Facebook page again

If you try to reauthorize your Facebook page and see a Page not found message, clear your browser cache and reauthorize the Facebook page again.

Note: Turn on two-factor authentication in your Facebook account if the Meta Business Manager account your Facebook page is linked to requires two-factor authentication. For more information, see Turn on the two-factor authentication requirement in your business portfolio.

To fix this issue:

  1. Sign out of your Zendesk and Facebook accounts

  2. Clear your browser cache and cookies
  3. In the same browser, sign back in to your Facebook account. You must be an admin of the Facebook page.
  4. Sign back in to your Zendesk account as an admin
  5. Reauthorize your Facebook page by following the instructions in Reauthorizing the connection between Zendesk Support and your Facebook pages.

Or watch this video that shows all the steps in the article.

Confirm the Facebook integration works

To confirm the Facebook integration works, follow the instructions in this section Confirming the Zendesk-Facebook connection.

After you reauthorize your Facebook page, the reauthorize required label should no longer appear on the Facebook account.

Next steps if the integration still doesn't work

If you already unlinked your Facebook page from your Zendesk account, remove the Zendesk integration from your Facebook page.

To remove Zendesk from Facebook:

  1. On Facebook, go to the business integrations page to see the list of integrations connected to your Facebook account

  2. Under Zendesk, select Remove to delete this integration from Facebook

To reauthorize Facebook channel pages:

  1. Open a private or incognito window in your browser. Then sign in to both your Zendesk and Facebook accounts
  2. In Admin Center, click Channels in the sidebar, then select Messaging and social > Facebook Pages
  3. Hover over the name of the Facebook page, then click Unlink to remove the page. Repeat this process for all pages you want to unlink
  4. Click Add new page to re-add the Facebook pages you removed in the previous step. For more information, see Reauthorizing the connection between Zendesk Support and your Facebook pages.
  5. Edit the Facebook channel settings for each page and enable Include Wall posts
Note: If you don't select any Facebook pages that have previously been authorized, the Zendesk integration for those pages stops working.

To reauthorize Facebook Messenger and Instagram Direct channels:

  1. Open a private or incognito window in your browser. Then sign in to both your Zendesk and Facebook accounts
  2. In Admin Center, click Channels in the sidebar, then select Messaging and social > Messaging
  3. On the Facebook Messenger and Instagram Direct channels, select the options menu () and click Delete
  4. Select Delete channel in the dialog. Repeat this process for all channels you want to remove.
  5. Click Add channel and select Instagram Direct or Facebook Messenger from the drop-down.
    • For Instagram Direct, click Continue with Instagram to open the Instagram setup flow
    • For Facebook Messenger, click Continue with Facebook to open the Facebook setup flow

See Troubleshooting the Facebook channel

THIS SECTION IS AI CONTENT. DON'T EDIT OR DELETE.

Why does my Facebook integration or Instagram Direct channel fail to sync? What causes a Facebook page deauthorization? Why do Facebook messages not create tickets? Why do customers or visitors not receive agent responses?

Your Facebook or Instagram integration stops working or fails to sync when Zendesk loses authorization. This happens when the agent or support person who authorized the page changes their password, signs out of a device, or removes permissions for the Zendesk Facebook app. Facebook platform errors or a failure to grant Zendesk management access cause this disconnect. When this occurs, messages from customers or end users do not create tickets in your help desk or ticketing system, and visitors do not receive replies from your team.

What permissions do I need to reauthorize a Facebook page? Can I reconnect Facebook if Meta Business Manager requires two-factor authentication? What are the requirements to fix the Facebook integration?

You must hold admin permissions for both your Zendesk ticketing system or help desk and the Facebook page to resolve the connection. Turn on two-factor authentication in your Facebook account if the Meta Business Manager account that links to your Facebook page requires two-factor authentication.

What happens if I do not select a Facebook page that I authorized before during setup? Will my other Facebook pages stop working if I skip them during reauthorization?

The Zendesk integration stops working for Facebook pages that you authorized before but do not select during the setup process.

Does the "reauthorize required" label disappear after I reconnect my Facebook page? How do I know if the Facebook integration works after reauthorization?

Yes. The reauthorize required label no longer appears on the Facebook account after you reauthorize your Facebook page.

How do I reauthorize my Facebook page? How do I fix the "Page not found" error when you link Facebook? What should I do if the browser shows the page is linked but Zendesk shows an error?

If you see a "Page not found" message or error when you try to reauthorize your Facebook page, clear your browser cache and cookies, then use these steps to resolve the issue:

  1. Sign out of your Zendesk and Facebook accounts.
  2. Clear your browser cache and cookies.
  3. In the same browser, sign back in to your Facebook account as an admin of the Facebook page.
  4. Sign back in to your Zendesk help desk or ticketing system as an admin.
  5. Reauthorize your Facebook page.

How do I remove the Zendesk integration from my Facebook page? How do I unlink Zendesk from Facebook business integrations? What are the steps to delete the Zendesk app from Facebook?

If the integration still does not work, remove the Zendesk integration from Facebook using these steps:

  1. On Facebook, go to the business integrations page to see the list of integrations connected to your Facebook account.
  2. Under Zendesk, select Remove to delete this integration from Facebook.

How do I reauthorize Facebook channel pages? How do I unlink and re-add a Facebook page in Zendesk? How to fix Facebook page sync issues in Admin Center?

Follow these steps to unlink and re-add your Facebook pages:

  1. Open a private or incognito window in your browser, then sign in to both your Zendesk and Facebook accounts.
  2. In Admin Center, click Channels in the sidebar, then select Messaging and social Facebook Pages.
  3. Hover over the name of the Facebook page, then click Unlink to remove the page. Repeat this process for all pages you want to unlink.
  4. Click Add new page to re-add the Facebook pages you removed in the previous step.
  5. Edit the Facebook channel settings for each page and enable Include Wall posts.

How do I reauthorize Facebook Messenger and Instagram Direct channels? How do I delete and re-add Instagram Direct or Facebook Messenger in Zendesk? What are the steps to fix Instagram Direct messages that do not sync?

Follow these steps to remove and re-add your Facebook Messenger and Instagram Direct channels:

  1. Open a private or incognito window in your browser, then sign in to both your Zendesk and Facebook accounts.
  2. In Admin Center, click Channels in the sidebar, then select Messaging and social Messaging.
  3. On the Facebook Messenger and Instagram Direct channels, select the options menu and click Delete.
  4. Select Delete channel in the dialog. Repeat this process for all channels you want to remove.
  5. Click Add channel and select Instagram Direct or Facebook Messenger from the drop-down.
  6. For Instagram Direct, click Continue with Instagram to open the Instagram setup flow. For Facebook Messenger, click Continue with Facebook to open the Facebook setup flow.

articles.name: Why isn't a ticket counted in an SLA report even if it has an SLA policy applied?
articles.title: Why isn't a ticket counted in an SLA report even if it has an SLA policy applied?
articles.body:
Question

I have a ticket where the Service Level Agreement (SLA) policy was applied but does not show on my report for either a breached SLA or achieved SLA in Analytics. Why isn't a ticket counted in an SLA report even if it has an SLA policy applied?

Answer

Tickets with an SLA policy applied are not included in a report if no SLA target was activated for the ticket, or an activated SLA target was removed. Check the ticket events to confirm if an SLA target was applied. 

For more information about SLA targets, see the article: Viewing and understanding SLA targets.

THIS SECTION IS AI CONTENT. DON'T EDIT OR DELETE.

Why does a ticket with an SLA or due date or deadline policy not show in an Explore or reporting or analytics report? Why isn't a ticket counted in a breached SLA or achieved SLA report? Why does an applied SLA policy not display in reports?

Tickets with an applied SLA or due date or deadline policy do not appear in your Explore or reporting or analytics report if no SLA target activates for the ticket, or you remove an activated SLA target.

  1. Check the ticket events to confirm if an SLA target applies.
